widgets.label: Refit Alignment (from calibration)
widgets.comments: Re-fit the live alignment transformer from the stored calibration buffer, without re-running calibration -- CALIBRATED or LIVE.

widgets.label: Auto-start on select
widgets.comments: Checkbox: checked = auto-start the transition as soon as a thumbnail is selected; unchecked = wait for the Start button.

widgets.default: Transition duration (seconds to reach the target)

widgets.label: #{@{this.value} === 1 ? 'Stop' : 'Start'}
widgets.comments: bypass:true stops this widget's own address from auto-firing on every value change (including a /SET feedback push, which would otherwise re-trigger a send and flip forever) -- onTouch below sends explicitly on real presses only, since send() ignores bypass. With bypass:true, `value` in onTouch is still the pre-press value (bypass suppresses the toggle's own local flip too, not just its OSC send), so send the inverse rather than `value` itself.

widgets.default: Noise amount (multiples of each dimension's natural variation; 1 = typical)
Noise walk time (s) -- lower = faster wander
Truncation (1 = off; lower pulls toward the average face, fixing stray/odd vectors)
